# For Joseph, Finding the Right Medicare Plan for Him Started with Someone Who Listened


*After years of confusing promises and disappointing coverage, **[eHealth](http://www.ehealthinsurance.com/)** helped Joseph A. find a plan that aligned to his budget and supported care for a chronic condition*


Joseph A. had heard the promises before.


People


would call claiming to have the best plan for him. But after


reviewing the details or even enrolling


, Joseph often discovered


important


factors


had been overlooked.


“I had people call and tell me they had the best plans,”


said


Joseph


, 70, of Navasota, Texas


. “Then it turned out the plan wasn’t as good as they claimed.”


His experience with


eHealth


was different.


**An advisor who took the time to listen**


Instead of pushing a single plan, Joseph’s


licensed insurance agent at


eHealth


spent about two hours learning about his health,


preferred


prescriptions,


and


budget. She then compared the available plans to find one that m


atched


his specific needs.


“She went above and beyond,” Joseph said. “She looked at every plan she could find to get me the best deal.”


Joseph noted that


p


revious


advisors


often seemed more interested in completing an enrollment


instead of


answering his questions. His


eHealth


a


dvisor


slowed the process down, reviewed multiple


options


and explained what he could expect from each one.


“


eHealth


was the first


company


to explain how this all works,” Joseph said.


**Looking beyond promises of prescription coverage**


Understanding the


coverage


details was important because Joseph lives


with


a


chronic


condition


.


He previously took


a specific


medication


,


so it was important to find a plan that covered that prescription drug


.


Joseph said other advisors had told him the medication would be covered without clearly explaining prior-authorization requirements or whether he would first have to try other drugs. Those omissions sometimes became


apparent


only after he had enrolled.


“Other people didn’t mention


that


,


” he recalled


.


“


They just said the drug would be covered.”


Trying another


prescription


wasn’t


a simple solution


, as other medications had caused


severe side effects


.


“I had one that nearly killed me,” Joseph recalled. “I went from 165 pounds down to 128 pounds in three weeks.”


His e


Health


advisor


recommended a


plan


covered


his preferred medication from the start, while


aligning with his monthly budget


.


**Relief from Medicare shopping frustration**


By the time Joseph contacted


eHealth


, shopping for Medicare coverage had become exhausting.


Comparing thick plan documents on his own felt overwhelming, while online research often produced more questions than answers.


“That big


Medicare


book


from the government


—


I couldn’t understand how to read it to save my life,” he said. “Then I went


online


and tried to figure it out, but I was still lost.”


The volume of unsolicited Medicare


plan sales


calls added to th


e


frustration


, so much so


that he stopped answering his phone unless he recognized the number.


“


T


hey just wanted to push one plan, whether


or not


it was


right


for you


,


”


he said


Finding an affordable plan matters to Joseph, who


lives


largely on


Social Security after a working life that included jobs as a plumber, in a mattress factory and at a copper mine.


But saving money was only part of what made his


eHealth


experience different


, helping


restore some of the trust Joseph had lost after years of overpromis


es


from other advisors.


“


eHealth


was the first one to really


care about me


,” he said.
